title: Data for residue-normalized completed lisse comparison
statement:
Define Base as a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and a Noetherian separated scheme X with l invertible in every residue field. Define the following record types and their underlying categories and maps. Their clauses specify data and equations, and this definition asserts no inhabitance: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite with valuation ring $A$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $X$ be a Noetherian separated scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible. On $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $B_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and $E_X=B_X[1/\varpi]$. A lisse $B_X$-module (respectively $E_X$-module) means a sheaf of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] pro-etale locally finite free over that coefficient sheaf, allowing rank zero and varying finite local ranks.

Reduction $N\mapsto(N/\varpi^nN)_{n\geq1}$ is an equivalence from lisse $B_X$-modules to the category of normalized inverse systems of finite locally free $A/\varpi^n$-module sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], with locally constant finite rank: transition maps induce $N_{n+1}\otimes_{A/\varpi^{n+1}}A/\varpi^n\cong N_n$. The inverse is $\varprojlim_n\nu_X^*N_n$, where $\nu_X^*$ is the etale-to-pro-etale inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. The functor from the raw $A$-linear localization of this lisse integral category to lisse $E_X$-modules, $N\mapsto N[1/\varpi]$, is fully faithful.

The reduction and inverse-limit equivalences, and this fully faithful rational realization, commute with module pullback on lisse objects and with finite coefficient extension. Their comparisons are the ones induced by the finite-level module pullbacks and scalar-extension maps, and satisfy the identity and composition equations. This node defines the types Base, Comparison, Arrow, Operation and System expressing these data and equations, and asserts no inhabitance. It also defines their underlying categories, fixed scalar maps, finite-level functors and actual tensor adjunction units. The identity and composition equations and all finite-level, inverse-limit and rational generator normalizations are part of the record types. IntegralComparison groups the integral fields of Comparison, IntegralOperation groups the integral fields of Operation, and SystemCore groups the ambient comparison/operation and tensor coherence fields of System. The original records inherit these fields; no field or normalization is added or removed by this grouping.
